data.name: Top Class Education Scheme for SC Students
data.provider: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
data.eligibility: SC students having total family income from all sources up to ₹8.00 lakh per annum who have secured admission in notified premier institutions (such as IITs, NITs, IIMs, AIIMS).
data.amount: Full tuition fee + living expenses of ₹3,000/month + books allowance of ₹5,000/year + computer assistance up to ₹45,000
data.application_process:
Step 1: Register on the National Scholarship Portal (NSP) at scholarships.gov.in.
Step 2: Authenticate using Aadhaar or OTR (One-Time Registration).
Step 3: Fill application form and select 'Top Class Education for SC'.
Step 4: Upload caste certificate, income certificate, and fee receipt from the notified institution.
Step 5: Submit application online for institutional verification.

data.name: Post Matric Scholarship for SC Students
data.eligibility: SC students pursuing recognized post-matriculation courses. Family income below ₹2.5 lakh per annum. Minimum 50% aggregate in preceding qualifying examination.
data.amount: Maintenance allowance ₹2,500 to ₹13,500/year + mandatory non-refundable fees reimbursed
data.application_process:
Step 1: Visit https://scholarships.gov.in
Step 2: Complete OTR using Aadhaar
Step 3: Select 'Post Matric Scholarship for SC Students'
Step 4: Fill personal and academic details
Step 5: Upload caste and income certificates
Step 6: Submit application online and notify college verification officer.

data.name: Saksham Scholarship Scheme for Specially Abled Students
data.provider: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE)
data.eligibility: Specially-abled students with 40% or more disability admitted to 1st year degree/diploma technical courses. Family income must not exceed ₹8 lakh per annum.
data.amount: ₹50,000 per annum for every year of study towards college fees, purchase of computers and assistive aids
data.application_process:
Step 1: Register on NSP (National Scholarship Portal).
Step 2: Submit Unique Disability ID (UDID) certificate and admission letter.
Step 3: Provide family income declaration.
Step 4: Complete institutional verification on the portal.

data.name: Merit-cum-Means Scholarship for Professional & Technical Courses
data.eligibility: Students from minority communities (Muslims, Christians, Sikhs, Buddhists, Jains, Parsis) pursuing professional or technical degree courses. Minimum 50% marks in previous exam; annual parental income not exceeding ₹2.5 lakh.
data.amount: Course fee reimbursement up to ₹20,000/year + maintenance allowance of ₹1,000/month for hostellers (₹500/month for day scholars)
data.application_process:
Step 1: Visit https://scholarships.gov.in
Step 2: Complete OTR registration with Aadhaar
Step 3: Select Merit-cum-Means Scholarship for Minorities
Step 4: Upload minority community self-declaration, income certificate, and admission proof
Step 5: Submit application online.

data.name: Gujarat BCK-7 Private Coaching Assistance for SC Students
data.provider: Government of Gujarat - Scheduled Caste Welfare
data.eligibility: SC students studying in Std. 11 or 12 Science stream in Gujarat. Student must have 70% or more marks in Std. 10. Family income limit is ₹6.00 lakh per year.
data.amount: ₹15,000 for Std. 11 and ₹15,000 for Std. 12 coaching assistance
data.application_process: Apply online through the Digital Gujarat portal (digitalgujarat.gov.in) and upload class 10 mark sheet, caste certificate, and coaching enrollment proof.

data.name: Karnataka State Scholarship Programme (SSP)
data.provider: Government of Karnataka - Social Welfare Department
data.eligibility: Karnataka domicile students pursuing post-matric courses. Belongs to SC/ST/OBC category. Family annual income within state prescribed limits.
data.amount: Full maintenance fees and tuition waiver according to student category and course tier
data.application_process:
Step 1: Visit ssp.karnataka.gov.in
Step 2: Enter Student Kutumba ID / Aadhaar
Step 3: Fetch verified caste and income certificate online
Step 4: Enter college registration number (USN/Roll No)
Step 5: Submit for e-attestation and department approval.

data.name: Nagaland State Research Scholarship
data.provider: Government of Nagaland - Directorate of Higher Education
data.eligibility: Indigenous Naga students registered for M.Phil or Ph.D. degrees in recognized universities with at least 55% aggregate at master's level.
data.amount: Monthly research stipend as per Nagaland Directorate of Higher Education guidelines
data.application_process: Apply through the Nagaland Common Scholarship Portal (scholarship.nagaland.gov.in) with synopsis and research guide endorsement.
